description: Standalone operator tools bundled with NANOMITE. Not part of the agent tool catalog.

authorization.mechanism: local root (sudo) password verified by sudo; nothing stored

inventory.purpose: Host discovery and baseline drift detection

tools.name: passive_network_inventory.py
tools.summary: Passive ARP inventory of the local subnet; ARP-cache fallback for non-root.

tools.name: baseline_comparator.py
tools.summary: Diff current inventory vs baseline; flags new hosts, MAC changes, removals.

recon.purpose: Port scanning, DNS enumeration, WHOIS/RDAP, and OSINT harvesting

tools.name: port_scanner.py
tools.summary: Concurrent TCP connect scan with optional banner grabbing; CIDR/target-file input, JSON output.

tools.name: subdomain_enum.py
tools.summary: DNS brute-force subdomain enumeration with wildcard detection.

tools.name: whois_rdap.py
tools.summary: WHOIS (port 43) and RDAP lookup with IANA referral following; JSON output.

tools.name: theharvester.py
tools.summary: Wrapper for theHarvester email, subdomain, and host harvesting from public sources.

tools.name: spiderfoot.py
tools.summary: Wrapper for SpiderFoot (200+ OSINT modules).

tools.name: recon_ng.py
tools.summary: Wrapper for Recon-ng modular OSINT framework.

tools.name: maltego.py
tools.summary: Wrapper for Maltego CE; GraphML export for visual link analysis.

web.purpose: Web misconfiguration scanning, content discovery, TLS audit

tools.name: web_vuln_scan.py
tools.summary: Read-only scan of headers, cookies, CORS, methods, exposed paths, listing, version disclosure, TLS.

tools.name: dir_buster.py
tools.summary: Content discovery with wildcard/soft-404 filtering and extension expansion.

tools.name: tls_audit.py
tools.summary: Protocol support, negotiated cipher, certificate subject/SAN/expiry.

cracking.purpose: Hash identification, offline cracking, wordlist generation

tools.name: hash_identifier.py
tools.summary: Identify hash formats from prefix/shape.

tools.name: hash_cracker.py
tools.summary: Multiprocessing dictionary cracker (MD5/SHA*/NTLM/crypt) with mutation rules.

tools.name: wordlist_generator.py
tools.summary: Case/leet/suffix wordlist mutations bounded by length and count.

exploitation.purpose: Authorized-only exploitation (runner + planner) and default-credential hygiene

tools.name: authorize.py
tools.summary: Verify the local root (sudo) password via sudo; nothing is stored or logged.

tools.name: exploit_runner.py
tools.summary: Authorized-only, non-destructive proof-of-access checks (traversal read, exposed files, default creds, unauth Redis, anon FTP) with evidence metadata.

tools.name: exploit_planner.py
tools.summary: Planning surface: maps services/findings to techniques, detection steps, evidence, references.

tools.name: default_cred_check.py
tools.summary: Small fixed default-credential list against HTTP Basic/FTP, rate-limited, masked.

wireless.purpose: Wi-Fi rogue-AP detection and wifite wrapper

tools.name: rogue_ap_detector.py
tools.summary: Compare nearby APs against an authorized SSID->BSSID allow-list.

tools.name: wifite_py3_minimal.py
tools.summary: Minimal Python 3 placeholder for wifite; points to upstream.

tools.name: generate_report.py
tools.summary: Render a Markdown report to PDF/DOCX (scenario-specific hardcoded paths).
